Source-to-sink on tag 4.1.6 (58c1d7f2fa36f7074664fc6d862afee0ca8bcc89): phpmyfaq/pdf.php is a public GET /pdf.php?cat=&id= path that optionally reads a session (anonymous user id -1) and, without any publication check, calls $faq->getFaq($faqId) then Pdf::generateFile($faq->faqRecord).

At 4.1.6, phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Faq.php getFaq() (line 599) loads via getFaqResult() whose WHERE is id+lang plus QueryHelper::queryPermission only (no fd.active). For non-admin callers it replaces only the answer with err_inactiveArticle while copying title (thema), solution_id, author, and date verbatim. generateFile then writes those four fields into the PDF (title ~216, solution_id ~246, author ~255, last-update date ~259).

The same loader/sink pairing already exists at BIC 4639bf25d8b4b7026527c012e9b9f94767247bf6: PMF_Faq::getRecord() SELECTs faqdata by id and lang with no active predicate, sets content to err_inactiveArticle when active is not yes, and pdf.php writes faqRecord title, solution_id, author, and date into the generated PDF.

On 4.1.7, phpmyfaq/pdf.php:149-152 calls isFaqRecordVisible() immediately after getFaq() and returns HTTP 404 before category assignment or generateFile().

Direct fix is commit b0daab0c2dedb880b2a9296082b7f1ba7a146cf8 (Author Thorsten Rinne <thorsten@phpmyfaq.de>, 2026-08-02, message 'fix: prevented metadata disclosure of unpublished FAQs on public read paths', single parent eceecd3185823d225bbe0af40bc733d73cb771cf).

The pdf.php hunk inserts, immediately after $faq->getFaq($faqId), if (!$faq->isFaqRecordVisible()) { setStatusCode(HTTP_NOT_FOUND); send; exit; } so inactive/unpublished metadata never reaches generateFile.

The same commit adds Faq::isFaqRecordVisible() which returns false for empty records, solution_id 42, active !== 'yes', dateStart in the future, or dateEnd in the past — closing the publication-state hole the PDF path inherited from getFaq()/getRecord().

findings: CVE-2026-76206 is a real published CWE-200: the public PDF export loads a FAQ by numeric id without an active/publication gate, redacts only the answer body, and writes title, solution_id, author, and last-update date into a downloadable PDF.

The smallest surviving public BIC is 4639bf25d8b4b7026527c012e9b9f94767247bf6 (2006-08-13 'Removed query'), which replaced pdf.php's local SQL active = 'yes' predicate with PMF_Faq::getRecord() that never filtered active. Parent 7e06d6df29d235f5d9905683fbdee57598d19187 still had that predicate and exited when no active row was found.

Tag 4.1.6 (58c1d7f2fa36f7074664fc6d862afee0ca8bcc89) contains the BIC and not the fix; tag 4.1.7 (28d6f641c16e3015d51d0a01d14841b845251f35) contains direct fix b0daab0c2dedb880b2a9296082b7f1ba7a146cf8, which 404s on !isFaqRecordVisible() before PDF generation.

BIC author and committer are named human thorstenr / Thorsten Rinne with no AI/bot/generator/co-author marker on the BIC object. The required closed verdict is therefore NOT_AI. Independent re-research agrees with the primary on BIC, parent, fix, releases, and attribution; no field corrections.
